purpose: Robustness check of without_dttl vs 42-feature baseline; not an independent test
ci_note: t-based 95% CIs are exploratory: repeated splits share data and are not independent

decision_rule.C1: without_dttl FPR lower than baseline on at least 4 of 5 seeds
decision_rule.C2: mean FPR reduction > noise-control spread, defined as mean |FPR(baseline_alt) - FPR(baseline)| across seeds
decision_rule.C3: mean overall recall drop <= 0.2 percentage points
decision_rule.C4: mean recall drop <= 1.0 percentage point for each of Fuzzers and Analysis
